commit.message:
Clarify that v1 powers drops and v2 powers ERC-1155 open collections (#202)

## Motivation

The README and `docs/Deployments.md` (#197, #198) said ERC-1155 drops on
OpenSea use SeaDrop v2. That's not how OpenSea uses v2 today. SeaDrop v1
powers OpenSea drops. v2 currently powers ERC-1155 open collections,
which the collection owner mints.

## Solution

Rewords the v1/v2 note in the README's Deployments section and in the
doc's "What OpenSea uses" section:

- **v1:** OpenSea drops. Clones from `ERC721SeaDropCloneFactory` or
standalone `ERC721SeaDrop` tokens, minting through `SeaDrop`.
- **v2:** ERC-1155 open collections, as clones from
`ERC1155SeaDropCloneFactory`, where the owner mints through the token's
configurer. Earlier v2 ERC-1155 drops, which mint through Seaport 1.6
orders, are still live, but OpenSea no longer creates them.

This matches os2-core's drop creation: the only v2 type
`CreatorStudioDeployContractHelper` accepts is the ERC-1155 self-mint
clone. `docs/Deployments.md` gets the same change on both branches.
